# Public API native boundary witness

This test-only optional companion to the independently installable Alpha/Beta consumers closes the named single-call/data-boundary question through the public API. Compose `control.lua`, `data-final-fixes.lua` and the selected engine-specific info renamed to `info.json`. Use the existing `Invoke-NativeFixture.ps1 -CreateOnly -CaseName api-boundary -ConsumerMarkers MIR5_API_BOUNDARY` path and exact owned archives/profile. No new runner or player helper is included.

During final fixes it immediately publishes one single technology, mutates its submitted fields and checks isolation, catches duplicate-identity and invalid-family calls with the expected public error codes, checks the two rejected names remain absent, and publishes a two-row local-forward-reference family with preserved returned order. Mutation of returned names leaves prototypes intact. The existing Automation table remains the same sentinel. These are bounded named witnesses, not exhaustive native schema validation or a foreign remote-interface collision experiment.

Initialization checks the three native rows, exactly representable `0.03125` single effect, fresh unresearched levels, rejected-row absence and detached read-only remote queries. It reports one `[MIR5_API_BOUNDARY] RESULT` row with stage `init`. No research setters, settings/entity/inventory writes, storage, GUI, saves or recurring handlers are used. Its bounded data-stage publication exists only in disposable fixture worlds. No gameplay production, save/reload, timing, API stability or release verdict follows from CreateOnly success; the separate existing Beta production fixture owns the Space Age physical question.
